class Node:
    def __init__(self, val):
        self.val = val
        self.left = None
        self.right = None

def find_highest_common_ancestor(root, node1, node2):
    if not root:
        return None
    
    if root == node1 or root == node2:
        return root
    
    left = find_highest_common_ancestor(root.left, node1, node2)
    right = find_highest_common_ancestor(root.right, node1, node2)
    
    if left and right:
        return root
    
    return left or right

# Example usage:

root.left = Node(5)
root.right = Node(1)
root.left.left = Node(6)
root.left.right = Node(2)
root.right.left = Node(0)
root.right.right = Node(8)

root.left.right.right = Node(4)

node1 = root.left.left  # Node with value 6
node2 = root.left.right.right  # Node with value 4

hca = find_highest_common_ancestor(root, node1, node2)
print("Highest Common Ancestor value:", hca.val)  # Output: 5
